```{python}
standard_height = 4
def compute_height(n):
    if n is None:
        n = 3
    if n == 3:
        h = standard_height - 1
    elif n == 2:
        h = standard_height - 2
    elif n == 1:
        h = standard_height - 3
    else:
        h = standard_height
    return max(h, 3)
```
